name: Pile of Patterned Dresses
description: Photogrammetry scan of a pile of patterned dresses with varied fabrics, folds, and overlapping layers. Captures intricate textile details, including floral prints, color variation, and natural cloth deformation. Ideal for realism-driven scenes, interior props, wardrobe clutter, or asset baking. The scan preserves fine surface detail and organic shapes, suitable for close-up rendering and optimization workflows.
